parsed.explanation: Part (ii) is the whole lower bound (L3.3): every refinement of {d,2d,...,2^q d} by at most q splits has Delta >= d. The written proof rests on an unproved invariant. Xiang's cuts are at arbitrary positions, so a cut inside a column need not align with the mental d-strips; the sentence 'two identical copies of all preceding strips plus one parity interchange, preserves this alternative' asserts the inductive step without argument, and the 'either a whole d-strip remains, or every column has been cut' dichotomy is never verified for cuts at non-multiples of d. Nowhere else in the text is (ii) proved; Section 3 merely applies it, and the full proof is deferred to an external file lemmas/refinement.md not included here.
